regions.name: EUROPE
regions.text: The European Central Bank, the central bank for the euro area, kept its interest rates unchanged.

cover_dek: New figures show growth and rising inflation in the United States.
big_headline: Third-quarter U.S. gross domestic product increases a better-than-expected 3.4%.
big_body: Gross domestic product, the total value of goods and services produced, rose as September inflation, the rate at which prices increase, accelerated.
pol_body: The US central bank kept interest rates unchanged. Traders are now pricing in a 78% chance of a rate hike in December.
pol_stat_l2: for a rate hike in December
biz_body: It kept its target range at 3.75% to 4% on Oct. 28. Two officials dissented, favoring an immediate quarter-point hike.
up_headline: Europe: Central bank chief to leave
up_body: Christine Lagarde will step down on 7 February 2027, nine months before the end of her eight-year term at the European Central Bank.
